references.text: Moses also spends forty days in the wilderness, which mirrors Jesus' forty days in the wilderness.
Reference to angels who serve, as in Mark 1:13.
Isaiah predicts a voice in the wilderness preparing the way for the Lord, which can be related to Jesus' time in the wilderness.
Matthew's account of Jesus' temptation in the wilderness, parallel to Mark 1:13.
Luke's detailed narrative of Jesus' temptation, providing a parallel to the events in Mark 1:13.
